ns2:section.sectionText: Students choosing to participate in this pilot study will be involved in a research project exploring the potential for using Tablet PC's to collect data from students in UIUC classrooms and use that data to create useful computer applications for learning. The study will explore the kinds of data that can be collected and used to better design instruction, improve the responsiveness of professors, and help students learn more effectively and efficiently. Students enrolled in this pilot course will attend lectures in the Educational Technologies Laboratory in Siebel Center 1129 which is equipped with tablet computers for use by each student and the instructor. Students will use their tablets for note taking and other course related activities. The instructor will use a tablet to present his lecture. Students interested in participating in this study will be graded independently of the regular CS125 lecture and will not be required to sign up for an additional laboratory section.
